results.name: Polynomial.Monic.eq_X_add_C
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.eq_X_add_C (hm : p.Monic) (hnd : p.natDegree = 1) : p = X + C (p.coeff 0) := by
  rw [← one_mul X, ← C_1, ← hm.coeff_natDegree, hnd, ← eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hnd.le]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_add_C
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_add_C (x : R) : Monic (X + C x) :=
  pow_one (X : R[X]) ▸ monic_X_pow_add_C x one_ne_zero

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_pow_add {n : ℕ} (H : degree p < n) : Monic (X ^ n + p) :=
  monic_of_degree_le n
    (le_trans (degree_add_le _ _) (max_le (degree_X_pow_le _) (le_of_lt H)))
    (by rw [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt H, add_zero])

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_sub_C (x : R) : Monic (X - C x) := by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, C_neg] using monic_X_add_C (-x)

@[simp]
lemma dvd_pow_self_iff {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    x ∣ x ^ n ↔ n ≠ 0 ∨ IsUnit x := by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp [isUnit_iff_dvd_one]
  · simp [hn, dvd_pow_self]

results.name: QuantumMechanics.radiusRegPowCLM
results.source_text:
/-- The radius operator to power `s`, regularized by `ε ≠ 0`, is the continuous linear map
  from `𝓢(Space d, ℂ)` to itself which maps `ψ` to `(‖x‖² + ε²)^(s/2) • ψ`. -/
def radiusRegPowCLM {d : ℕ} (ε : ℝˣ) (s : ℝ) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ) →L[ℂ] 𝓢(Space d, ℂ) :=
  SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℂ (Complex.ofReal ∘ normRegularizedPow d ε s)
results.docstring:
The radius operator to power `s`, regularized by `ε ≠ 0`, is the continuous linear map
from `𝓢(Space d, ℂ)` to itself which maps `ψ` to `(‖x‖² + ε²)^(s/2) • ψ`.

results.name: QuantumMechanics.radiusRegPowCLM_apply_fun
results.source_text:
lemma radiusRegPowCLM_apply_fun {d : ℕ} (ε : ℝˣ) (s : ℝ) (ψ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    𝐫₀ ε s ψ = fun x ↦ (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) ^ (s / 2) • ψ x := by
  ext x
  dsimp [radiusRegPowCLM]
  refine smulLeftCLM_apply_apply ?_ ψ x
  exact HasTemperateGrowth.comp (by fun_prop) (normRegularizedPow_hasTemperateGrowth d ε s)

results.name: Polynomial.normalizedGcdMonoid
results.source_text:
noncomputable instance normalizedGcdMonoid : NormalizedGCDMonoid R[X] :=
  letI := Classical.decEq R
  normalizedGCDMonoidOfExistsLCM fun p q => by
    rcases exists_primitive_lcm_of_isPrimitive p.isPrimitive_primPart
        q.isPrimitive_primPart with
      ⟨r, rprim, hr⟩
    refine ⟨C (lcm p.content q.content) * r, fun s => ?_⟩
    by_cases hs : s = 0
    · simp [hs]
    by_cases hpq : C (lcm p.content q.content) = 0
    · rw [C_eq_zero, lcm_eq_zero_iff, content_eq_zero_iff, content_eq_zero_iff] at hpq
      rcases hpq with (hpq | hpq) <;> simp [hpq, hs]
    iterate 3 rw [dvd_iff_content_dvd_content_and_primPart_dvd_primPart hs]
    nontriviality R
    rw [(associated_content_mul ..).dvd_iff_dvd_left, rprim.content_eq_one, mul_one, content_C,
      (associated_primPart_mul (mul_ne_zero hpq rprim.ne_zero)).dvd_iff_dvd_left, rprim.primPart_eq,
      normalize_lcm, lcm_dvd_iff,
      (isUnit_primPart_C (lcm p.content q.content)).mul_left_dvd, ← hr s.primPart]
    tauto

results.name: Polynomial.gcd_map
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_map [Field k] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq k] (f : R →+* k) :
    gcd (p.map f) (q.map f) = (gcd p q).map f :=
  GCD.induction p q (fun x => by simp_rw [Polynomial.map_zero, EuclideanDomain.gcd_zero_left])
    fun x y _ ih => by rw [gcd_val, ← map_mod, ih, ← gcd_val]

results.name: Polynomial.separable_gcd_right
results.source_text:
theorem separable_gcd_right {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F[X]]
    {g : F[X]} (f : F[X]) (hg : g.Separable) :
    (EuclideanDomain.gcd f g).Separable :=
  Separable.of_dvd hg (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right f g)

results.name: Polynomial.separable_gcd_left
results.source_text:
theorem separable_gcd_left {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F[X]]
    {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Separable) (g : F[X]) :
    (EuclideanDomain.gcd f g).Separable :=
  Separable.of_dvd hf (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left f g)

results.name: Informal.informalDefinitionDecl
results.source_text:
macro (name := informalDefinitionDecl)
doc?:(docComment)? attrs?:(attributes)? "informal_definition " name:ident body:declVal : command =>
  `($[$doc?]? $[$attrs?]? def $name : InformalDefinition $body:declVal)
results.docstring:
A placeholder for definitions to be formalized in the future. Docstrings of informal definitions
should outline its mathematical or physical content and specify useful references. Use the attribute
`note_attr_informal` from `Physlib.Meta.Notes.Basic` to mark the informal definition as a note.

results.name: Informal.constantInfoToInformalDefinition
results.source_text:
/-- Takes a `ConstantInfo` corresponding to a `InformalDefinition` and returns
  the corresponding `InformalDefinition`. -/
unsafe def constantInfoToInformalDefinition (c : ConstantInfo) : CoreM InformalDefinition := do
  match c with
  | .defnInfo c => evalConstCheck InformalDefinition ``InformalDefinition c.name
  | _ => panic!
    "Passed constantInfoToInformalDefinition a `ConstantInfo` that is not a `InformalDefinition`"

the corresponding `InformalDefinition`.
